scripts.text:
[Poring]
!!!!!
Whoa-! Humans, ring~!!
Gotta hide, hide, right~!
They're tempting us with Jellopy! Don't be fooled!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
!!!!!
Whoa-! 人类来了，ring~!!
快躲起来，快躲起来~！
他们用杰勒比结晶诱惑我们！别上当！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Hwak!!
Ring, Ring~ What's wrong with you people..?
Hey.. Hey, there. Hu.. Humans...
Poring..
scripts.translation:
[波利]
Hwak!!
Ring, Ring~ 你们这些人怎么回事...？
嘿...嘿，那边的人...人类...
波利...

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I.. I've got some interesting work for ya.. Would you be interested?
We.. we porings need lots and lots of brave human worriers, ring~.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我...我有份有趣的工作给你...有兴趣吗？
我...我们波利需要很多很多勇敢的人类战士，ring~。

scripts.text: Alright, I'm with you!
scripts.translation: 好的，我加入你们！

scripts.text: What's that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oh, and there's an entrance fee of 500 zeny, ring.
Have a good time, ring.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
哦，还要收500 Zeny的入场费，ring。
玩得开心，ring。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oh, and there's an entrance fee of 500 zeny, ring.
...........
Hey, that's life, ring. We need zeny too you know~!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
哦，还要收500 Zeny的入场费，ring。
...........
唉，这就是生活，ring。
我们也需要Zeny呀~！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
That's.. because there's been a.. slight confliction in our.. Ring Society..
So we've got to.............have a battle to settle this problem..
You'll see when you get there!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
那是...因为我们的...波利社会...起了一点小冲突...
所以必须...打一场，来解决问题...
到了那里你就明白了！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Huhhhh! Hu.. Humans are so cold and cruel!!!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
Huhhhh! 人...人类真是冷酷无情！！！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Oh, Another Human Warrior!
How come so many humans want to join our Poring War these days?
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
哦，又来了一位人类战士！
最近怎么这么多人类想加入我们的波利战争呢？

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Well, whatever, as long as I make money out of it~
Ok, Warriors-! Hahaha How badly have I wanted to shout it out~!!
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
算了，能赚钱就行~
好，战士们——！Hahaha 我早就想这么喊了~！！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
You, brave warrior, are you ready to join the holy battle of Angeling and Deviling?
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
勇敢的战士啊，你准备好加入天使波利与恶魔波利的神圣之战了吗？

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Hehehee, I feel kinda shy now.
Anyway, human. Do you want to join our Poring War?
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
Hehehee，现在反倒有点害羞了。
总之，人类，要参加我们的波利大战吗？

scripts.text: Am I qualified to join?
scripts.translation: 我有资格加入吗？

scripts.text: How do I join the war?
scripts.translation: 怎么参加波利大战

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Let me out of here, please!
scripts.translation: 请让我离开这里！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
No racial discrimination! Anyone can join if they're willing to fight.
But the weird thing is that you humans who used to be our greatest enemies are now our participants.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
我们不歧视任何种族！
只要愿意战斗，谁都能参加。
不过，你们人类从前可是我们最大的敌人，现在居然成了参战者，真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
If you really want to fight in the war or whatever.. the Team recruiter's right there.
Also, it's totally up to you which team you want to fight for~
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
想参加战斗什么的...去找那边的队伍招募员就行。
为哪一方而战，完全由你自己决定~

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
It's simple. You see that Team recruiting room?
Each team is composed of 5 people. As soon as 5 members are collected, the battle starts.
You win if you kill the other team's Porings.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
很简单，看到那个队伍招募室了吗？
每边有5名成员，集齐5人就开始战斗。
消灭对方的波利，就能获胜。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
This also means that the battle needs the total of 10 members.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
这也意味着战斗总共需要10名成员。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
When all 10 members are collected, those participants get to choose a team. Each team then should have 5 members who are in the SAME party.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
集齐10人后，大家选择阵营。
每边都要有5名成员，而且这5人必须属于同一支队伍。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
So, finally, half of the members joins the Angeling Team
and the other half joins the Deviling Team.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
所以，最终，一半的成员加入天使波利队，另一半加入恶魔波利队。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
If you're a member of the Angeling Team, your goal is to kill the Devilings at the other team's base and vice versa.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
如果你是天使波利队的成员，你的目标是杀死对方基地的恶魔波利，反之亦然。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Each team should try killing both Porings in the other team's base. After killing one Poring, you have a limited time to kill the other Poring. Otherwise, the one you killed will come back alive.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
每边都要消灭对方基地的两只波利。
消灭一只后，必须在规定时间内消灭另一只，否则先被消灭的那只就会复活。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
It's sort of like a capture the flag game but with Porings instead. Understood?
And you need to make sure you know who's in which party.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
有点像夺旗游戏，只不过用波利代替旗子，明白了吗？
另外，要弄清楚谁属于哪支队伍。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
hmm, I see.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Oh, Alright. I can help.
I'll send you back to your savepoint.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
哦，好，我来帮你。
这就送你回保存点。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
So, everyone joined the party?
The name of the party is... {0}, right?
I'll transfer you to the battle staging area.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
大家都加入队伍了吗？
队伍名称是...{0}，对吧？
我这就送你去战斗集结区。

scripts.text: No! Wait!
scripts.translation: 不！等等！

scripts.text: Go to the staging area.
scripts.translation: 前往集结区

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
What is it now?
Can't you have a little more consideration?
You don't have much time. Decide now!
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
又怎么了？
就不能体谅一下我吗？
时间不多了，快做决定！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
If you don't get there in time, you won't make it to the battle.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
如果你不能及时赶到，就无法参加战斗了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
So, you are the leader. Before going to the battlefield, you should check all your members.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
你是队长吧。
去战场之前，先确认所有队员都准备好了。

scripts.text: Very well. I'll be the last.
scripts.translation: 好，我最后再走

scripts.text: I am the last. Send me to the battlefield.
scripts.translation: 我是最后一个，送我去战场

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
First, make sure all the members are in your party.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
首先，确保所有成员都在你的队伍中。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
Very well. Nice you have done everything on time.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
很好，你按时把一切都办妥了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
Right. I'm gonna send you to the battle staging area.
Wait for all the other party members there.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
好，我这就送你去战斗集结区。
在那里等其他队员到齐。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
So, you are the party leader of Angeling Team.
Are you sure all the members are in your party?
First, lets register your party name, after, we'll check the members.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
你是天使波利阵营的队长吧。
确认所有成员都在你的队伍里了吗？
先登记队伍名称，再核对队员。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
Lets see... The name of the party is...
 
^4d4dff {0} ^000000
 
Right? That is the name you wish?
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
让我看看...队伍名称是...
 
^4d4dff {0} ^000000
 
对吗？要登记这个名字吗？

scripts.text: No! You're wrong.
scripts.translation: 不，你搞错了

scripts.text: Yes. I would like to register that name.
scripts.translation: 对，就登记这个名字

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
Hey, I don't have all day! Make your mind and register as fast as you can.
Don't forget to let all the members join the party. Only the members of a registered party can join the battle.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
嘿，我可没时间一直等！
快做决定，尽快登记。
别忘了让所有成员加入队伍，只有登记队伍中的成员才能参战。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
So, I'll register your party name as - {0} -.
Now, Tell your ^4d4dffmembers to confirm your party^000000.
I'll send you to the battlefield as soon as I confirm your party.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
好，就把你的队伍名称登记为 - {0} -。
现在，让你的^4d4dff队员来确认所属队伍^000000。
确认完毕后，我就送你去战场。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
The clock is ticking. Make up your mind and register as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
时间不等人，快做决定，尽快登记。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
So, you are the leader of the party.
Haven't you finished the party registration yet?
You must stay on the one that has been registered!
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
你是队长吧。
还没完成队伍登记吗？
必须留在已经登记的队伍里！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
The name of the party is 
 {0}

scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
队伍名称是{0}，请确认。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
If you aren't a registered member of the party, you can't join the battle.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
如果你不是注册队伍的成员，你就不能参加战斗。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
I'll check again and, after the registeration of the party name, you'll be sent to the battlefield.
We must stay together as a party, since this is a team game. Otherwise, we'll have problems.

我会再核对一次，登记好队伍名称后，就送你去战场。
这是团队比赛，大家必须保持在同一支队伍里，否则会出问题。

首先，确保所有成员都在你的队伍中。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
Very well. Nice you have done everything on time.

[多佩尔先生]

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
Right. I'm gonna send you to the battle staging area.
Wait for all the other party members there.

[多佩尔先生]

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
So, you are the party leader of Deviling Team.
Are you sure all the members are in your party?
First, lets register your party name, after, we'll check the members.

[多佩尔先生]
你是恶魔波利阵营的队长吧。

先登记队伍名称，再核对队员。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
Lets see... The name of the party is...
 
^4d4dff {0} ^000000

^4d4dff {0} ^000000
 
对吗？要登记这个名字吗？

scripts.text: No! You're wrong.

scripts.text: Yes. I would like to register that name.

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]

[多佩尔先生]

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]

scripts.text:

The clock is ticking. Make up your mind and register as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
时间不等人，快做决定，尽快登记。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

The name of the party is 
 {0}

[Mr. Doppel]
If you aren't a registered member of the party, you can't join the battle.
scripts.translation:
[多佩尔先生]
如果你不是注册队伍的成员，你就不能参加战斗。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Doppel]
I'll check again and, after the registeration of the party name, you'll be sent to the battlefield.
We must stay together as a party, since this is a team game. Otherwise, we'll have problems.
